title: Banks Ask FDIC to Make Issuers Police Stablecoin Wallets
message_html: Banks Ask FDIC to Make Issuers Police Stablecoin Wallets ...
snippet: Proposed rulemaking by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. focuses on how payment stablecoin issuers should meet Bank Secrecy Act and sanctions obligations.
